messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "problems may occur when you first start taking tramadol"
set: ["problems may occur when you first start taking tramadol", "breathing problems may occur when first starting", "problems may occur when your dose is changed", "breathing problems may occur when dose is changed", "problems may occur if you take too much", "breathing problems may occur with overdose", "others may occur", "some young people may have thoughts about suicide when first taking antidepressant", "breathing problems or withdrawal symptoms if you start or stop taking certain other medicines", "serotonin syndrome can occur when taken alone", "seizures may occur with abrupt discontinuation", "other drugs can be dangerous when used with tramadol", "benzodiazepine sedatives can be dangerous when used with tramadol", "taking certain oral diabetes medicines may increase risk of serious heart problems", "may increase risk of muscle problems", "breathing problems may lead to death"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
